items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: At one time, this fellow, the little guitar player, what they call him, little Joe Hernandez, he used to play a little violin himself, but mostly he played guitar.

ctx.x: But back in Jack Lane's days, he didn't use a violin... Well, yeah.

At one time, this fellow, the little guitar player, what they call him, little Joe Hernandez, he used to play a little violin himself, but mostly he played guitar. But it's very seldom that he used it. What about Watsky? He just used it now and then, you know what I mean?

What about Watsky? Did you ever know him? A violin player named Watsky? King, Watsky, got everybody to know him. He may have been uptown or something. No, I don't know. I think maybe Bud Lloyd Cannon told me about him or something. I'm not sure what I've been talking about. You know where I'm telling him.
